leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement the map() method to transform arrays into HTML elements
Apply *ngFor directive to render dynamic lists in Angular templates
Construct components that display collections of data items
Configure proper tracking with trackBy functions for list performance
Bind individual array elements to template interpolation expressions
Manipulate list data to control which items appear in the rendered output
Integrate TypeScript array methods with Angular's template rendering system
